# World Battery Hub — Battery Manufacturer Directory

> A verified directory of battery manufacturers by region — China, Japan/Korea, Europe, the US, India and lithium EV — with evidence labels, company profiles and the checks that matter before an order.

## Core pages

- [Directory home](https://manufacturer.worldbatteryhub.com/): all 50 manufacturer profiles, by region.
- [China lead-acid manufacturers](https://manufacturer.worldbatteryhub.com/china-lead-acid-manufacturers/): the majors and the OEM/private-label long tail.
- [Korean & Japanese manufacturers](https://manufacturer.worldbatteryhub.com/korean-japanese-battery-manufacturers/): cell makers and technology leaders.
- [European manufacturers](https://manufacturer.worldbatteryhub.com/european-battery-manufacturers/): lead-acid, industrial and gigafactory-stage lithium.
- [US manufacturers](https://manufacturer.worldbatteryhub.com/us-battery-manufacturers/): domestic cell and pack capacity.
- [Indian manufacturers](https://manufacturer.worldbatteryhub.com/indian-battery-manufacturers/): local production and import-led demand.
- [Lithium EV manufacturers](https://manufacturer.worldbatteryhub.com/lithium-ev-manufacturers/): capacity concentration and market share.
- [Product verification](https://manufacturer.worldbatteryhub.com/product-verification/): how to verify a supplier claim.
- [Verification criteria](https://manufacturer.worldbatteryhub.com/verification-criteria/): the four evidence dimensions.

## Notes

- Verification labels describe the evidence held at the review date, not a quality ranking.
- Company facts are cross-checked against public sources; capacity and revenue figures are omitted where no linked source exists.
- The directory is informational; it is not a recommendation or a guarantee of any shipment.
